title: Blaize Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Blaize Holdings, Inc. (ticker: BZAI), a Nasdaq-listed AI/compute technology company based in California, filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026 announcing entry into a Rights Agreement (poison pill) with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company as Rights Agent. The company declared a dividend of one preferred stock purchase right per common share, effective for shareholders of record May 6, 2026.
key_points: Blaize Holdings, Inc. (BZAI) entered into a Rights Agreement on April 22, 2026 as a defensive measure against potential hostile takeover.
A dividend of one preferred stock purchase right was declared for each outstanding common share; record date is May 6, 2026.
Rights become exercisable when any person or group acquires 10% or more beneficial ownership (or announces a tender offer to do so).
Existing holders who already own 10%+ are grandfathered unless they acquire additional shares.
Rights expire April 21, 2027 unless earlier redeemed, exchanged, or terminated by the company.
Purchase price is $11.00 per one one-hundredth of a share of Series A Junior Participating Preferred Stock.
